issues.description: Contradictory numeric condition on the attribute 'einwohner_m': the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 44) requires counting Wanderwege that lead to Gemeinden with MORE THAN 500000 male inhabitants (condition einwohner_m > 500000), but the solution implementation (solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql line 4) uses the opposite comparator (AND einwohner_m < 500000). This logical contradiction will produce incorrect results and confuse students who compare their query to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to match the problem statement's requirement. Change the WHERE clause comparator on einwohner_m from '< 500000' to '> 500000' (e.g. AND einwohner_m > 500000) so the query counts Wanderwege to Gemeinden with more than 500000 male inhabitants. Verify any accompanying explanation or tests also reflect the 'mehr als 500 000' requirement.
